notes: Self-healing desktop: the Dock, Spotlight/Launchpad, the glass effects, gestures and full screen are each watched by a keeper that starts them again within a second if they ever stop, instead of staying gone until the next login
Faster startup: the login screen and desktop no longer wait for Wi-Fi/Ethernet to come up (applies from the next restart)
Window animations can no longer be lost for good after logging out or one bad start; an earlier wrongly-disabled state repairs itself
Updates no longer restart the Dock and Spotlight every time, only when their files changed; the background update check wakes every 30 minutes instead of every 2
Graphics speed floor is now set the moment the graphics card appears, so it can't be missed at startup; Night Shift and the appearance watcher no longer leave duplicates behind after logging out
summit-diagnose now reports startup timing and the state of each desktop part
